text:
maria: Quick design check — compare table on model catalog feels cramped when filters are pinned. Screenshot in thread.
dan: Agree. Pinning pushes the compare header offscreen on 1280x720; users lose the 'pin' affordance.
anjali: Can we collapse the badge column on narrow viewports? Maybe hide non-critical performance badges behind a chevron.
keegan: Hiding badges could break discovery. Suggest moving badges to a hover panel on rows for keyboard too.
jordan: Accessibility note: hover-only means keyboard/VO users won't reach them. Need focusable button and aria-expanded state.
maria: Good call. Proposal: responsive behavior — full badges at >=1360, condensed icon + tooltip at 1024-1360, overflow menu <1024.
dan: Prototype looks fine. One nit: tooltip text for 'perf' badge reads "Latency" but we should show median P50 + P95 in microcopy.
anjali: Also add a11y label: `aria-label="Latency P50 92ms, P95 210ms"` for screen readers.
keegan: Implementation question: should the pin state be per-user or per-organization? Product ok with per-user sticky pins.
maria: Per-user is best for now. We'll store in preferences key `catalog.compare.pinnedFilters`.
deploy-bot: deploy status: bumped branch `catalog-compact-badges` to staging.
dan: Copy tweak: change "Pin filters" -> "Keep filters visible" to be clearer for non-technical users.
jordan: Contrast check: the badge background doesn't meet 3:1 with white text at small sizes. Increase saturation or add stroke.
maria: I'll update comps. Next step: dev handoff for responsive behaviors + keyboard microinteractions. TL;DR: responsive badge tiers, keyboard-accessible overflow, per-user pinning, copy and a11y labels.
keegan: I'll take the dev ticket. Adding acceptance criteria: keyboard focus order, VO readout, tooltip content, unit tests for prefs.
anjali: Adding a couple of QA prompts: 1) Tab through filters with screen reader 2) Narrow viewport compare + pin persistence 3) Badge counts in hover panel.
maria: Thanks team. I'll upload final figma frames and the redlines by EOD. :tada:
